dz: 奥斯特罗哥特人之王维吉斯结束对罗马的围攻并撤退到拉文纳,将这座城市留给了胜利的拜占庭将领贝利萨里乌斯.
de: Vitiges, king of the Ostrogoths, ends his siege of Rome and retreats to Ravenna, leaving the city to the victorious Byzantine general, Belisarius.
